title: NSW Digital Photo Card (DPC) – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for using the NSW Digital Photo Card (DPC).
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account linked to your NSW Photo Card
A phone with a working, charged battery and an undamaged screen

faqs.q: Is the DPC a replacement for my physical card?
faqs.a: The DPC is an electronic version of a NSW Photo Card, but you should carry your plastic NSW Photo Card as a backup because it may not be accepted by everyone.

faqs.q: What do I need to ensure the DPC works when I need it?
faqs.a: You must ensure your phone is working, sufficiently charged, and that the screen is not cracked or damaged so that the DPC can be viewed clearly.

faqs.q: What happens if I misuse my DPC?
faqs.a: Service NSW reserves the right to disable your DPC by deactivating your MyServiceNSW Account and unlinking it from TfNSW if there is fraud or other unlawful use.
